provenance.machine: Apple M2 Max (8 performance + 4 efficiency cores)
provenance.sorted_corpus: every 17-character VIN in New York's public registration file, 11,926,226 unique VINs, byte-sorted
provenance.random_corpus: twenty million unique synthetic VINs in random order, ~95% valid and ~5% with one realistic defect
provenance.method: Disk to disk: `ultravin decode-compact SRC DST_DIR` from a release wheel reads a Parquet file of VINs and writes vins.parquet and vehicles.parquet. Each figure is rows divided by the wall time of whole fresh CLI processes, startup included, repeated until ten seconds have passed (one pass on the synthetic corpus). One run per cell; one-minute load average 3.0 at the start. Raw records, including twelve workers, in scripts/bench/headline_2026_11_14.json.
provenance.other_engines: corgi and NHTSA rows are their earlier published or measured figures; they were not re-run for this session.
